conclusion_affected: Tail-CF fee level (150 bps at $100k) and the share of tail CFs whose rule-A cost a published fee covers (33.7% at 150 bps)

question: Realised fee rates for the long tail from Form 990: for the 60 sampled sponsors, read Schedule D Part I and the audited statements (where posted) for administrative-fee revenue charged to DAFs or component funds, and compare realised bps with the published schedule (and infer it where no schedule is published)

question: Revise the long-tail admin-fee pool and coverage figures: replace the hypothetical 100 bps (top-100 median) in direction-long-tail-sponsors.md §0, strategic-synthesis.md and b45n33-long-tail-operating-cost.md §2.4 with the observed tail-CF range (published median 150 bps at $100k; 0-200 bps), stating that only 11.7% of tail sponsors publish a rate

question: Non-CF tail DAF programs: for the university/hospital, faith and single-issue sponsors in the tail (599 of 1,240), test whether DAFs are offered as a product at all (DAF page, agreement, or minimum published) using the same robots-checked crawl on a 60-sponsor stratified sample of non-CFs only; record restrictions such as Cal Poly Pomona's 50%-to-the-foundation rule
